title: Juniper and the Veil
premise: When the border wards between the human realm and the veiled lands of Thornfell collapse on the night the stars go out, mercenary Beatrix Okafor discovers her silent god, Juniper, was the ward's living anchor — and that her own sworn covenant was the lock. Hunted by both realms' authorities and guided by a ragtag found family of smugglers, exiles, and one repentant ward-breaker, she must carry a dying ember of divinity to the mountain's heart before the veil devours both worlds. In the end she learns the god went silent not from abandonment but from sacrifice, and Beatrix must choose between restoring Juniper at the cost of her memories of her chosen family, or letting the old order die and forging a new covenant built on mortal loyalty rather than divine law. She chooses the latter, becoming the veil's first human keeper.
about_author: R. M. Amberdale is the pen name of a former trail guide who spent a decade leading expeditions through remote mountain passes before turning to fiction. They write character-driven fantasy about borders — geographic, divine, and personal — from a cabin they refuse to locate precisely.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Beatrix Okafor finishes a smuggling run through Thornfell when the stars vanish and the border wards shatter like glass. Her god Juniper, silent for three years, screams through her covenant mark for the first time. POV: Beatrix. Emotional beat: dread and disorientation as the world she navigates by goes dark.

chapters.title: Every Road Has a Toll
chapters.summary: Fleeing ward-wardens who blame smugglers for the collapse, Beatrix shelters with her estranged crew: Halvard the forger, twins Sefi and Rook, and Ilsa, an exile who once served the ward-priests. POV: Beatrix. Emotional beat: wary reunion; loyalty tested by old betrayals, but family reassembles under pressure.

chapters.title: What the Mark Remembers
chapters.summary: Ilsa deciphers Beatrix's covenant mark: it isn't a brand of service but a keyhole. Juniper didn't abandon its faithful — it poured itself into the wards, and something deliberately broke them. POV: Ilsa. Emotional beat: revelation reframing silence as sacrifice, guilt curdling into resolve.

chapters.title: The Ward-Breaker's Confession
chapters.summary: The crew captures Corvin, a disgraced priest who admits he shattered the wards on orders from the Sunward Conclave, who want the veiled lands' magic harvested. He knows the way to the mountain's heart. POV: Corvin. Emotional beat: shame and self-justification colliding; justice outside the law begins to take shape.

chapters.title: Smuggler's Justice
chapters.summary: Conclave hunters ambush the crew at a river crossing. Sefi is gravely wounded shielding Corvin, forcing the crew to decide whether he's worth saving. They choose mercy over vengeance and vote to finish what Juniper started. POV: Rook. Emotional beat: grief transmuted into fierce, chosen loyalty.

chapters.title: The Hollow Shrine
chapters.summary: At Juniper's abandoned shrine, Beatrix communes with the god's fading ember and sees the truth: the Conclave's harvest would unravel both realms. The ember must reach the mountain's heart within nine days or the veil collapses entirely. POV: Beatrix. Emotional beat: awe and terror; the weight of purpose accepted.

chapters.title: Ninety-Nine Roads, One Pass
chapters.summary: The Conclave seals every known pass, so Halvard forges documents while the crew takes a suicidal smuggler's route through the Underthorn caverns. Betrayed by a tracker selling their location, they fight a running battle in the dark. POV: Halvard. Emotional beat: found family forged in fire; trust becomes survival.

chapters.title: The Price of the Ember
chapters.summary: The ember begins feeding on its bearer's memories. Beatrix starts forgetting her crew — names first, then faces. She hides it; Ilsa finds out and quietly records everything Beatrix loses. POV: Ilsa. Emotional beat: heartbreak and tenderness; love documented against erasure.

chapters.title: Heart of the Veil
chapters.summary: At the mountain's heart, the Conclave's archmagister offers Beatrix restoration of her god and her memories if she surrenders the ember to Conclave control. Climax: the crew arrives battered but whole, and Beatrix refuses — shattering the old covenant and pouring the ember into herself as the new keeper. POV: Beatrix. Emotional beat: sacrificial defiance; loyalty outweighs law.

chapters.title: A New Covenant
chapters.summary: The veil stabilizes around Beatrix, half-mortal, half-keeper, her lost memories returned because Ilsa wrote them down and the new covenant honors mortal witness. The Conclave falls to exposure; Corvin turns himself in to rebuild the priesthood honestly. POV: Beatrix. Emotional beat: bittersweet resolution — the god is gone, but the family remains, and the border finally belongs to no one and everyone.
